title: Enums with associated values, and pattern matching

videos.script: A day of the week is one of seven things. Never an eighth. This lesson writes types like that. {{cases}} An enum lists its values. Each can carry a raw value, a string or a number, for files and networks. {{assoc}} Then the part other languages lack. A case that carries its own data. A reading has pages. A video has minutes. And nothing has both. {{switch}} Then the switch, which must cover every case. Forget one, and the compiler names it for you. {{patterns}} Patterns that match two things at once, ranges, and conditions with where. {{optional}} Then a surprise you have already met. An optional is an enum, with two cases. {{state}} By the end, a study session has a life of its own. Planned, running, done or skipped, with every wrong move refused.
